thread:
maria-marketing: Quick ask — launch + webinar next Tue. Need a compact micro-infographic library (30–40 assets) that covers: latency vs cost, caching benefits, smart routing tiers, and a simple rollout diagram for canary/A-B/fallback. Outputs: Figma components, slide-ready PNGs, social PNG/SVGs. Can design take this on? :calendar:

jake-design: Yep — we can. Need the asset spec and a priority list. Any brand guardrails or localization? :eyes:

maria-marketing: Priority: 1) 3 hero tiles (webinar hero, launch hero, sales hero) 2) 8 modular explanation tiles (latency, batching, cache, quantization, routing, fallbacks, observability callouts, cost comparison) 3) 20 social variants (sizes: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 820x312). Localize EN/DE/FR. Brand: use primary palette + secondary accent only. Deadline: EOD Fri (4 days). Figma link: https://figma.com/file/example (edit access for design).

jake-design: Cool. Specs I want to confirm:
```
- Hero: 1600x900 @2x export PNG, layered Figma slide with notes
- Modular tiles: 1200x628 and 1080x1080 exports, SVG source for icons
- Fonts: Redwood Sans (heading), Redwood Mono (code snippets)
- Max copy per tile: 12 words headline, 25 words body
```
Doable?

oliver-creative: Style direction — keep icons geometric + thin stroke, use micro-animations for webinar hero (subtle token drop or spark). For slide pack include a build-in placeholder for speaker quote. I can mock 2 animation frames if that helps.

jake-design: Animation frames are helpful, we'll include Lottie/MP4 state for the hero. For social we’ll export static PNG + one MP4 teaser variant each.

sam-solutions: For the technical tiles (cache, routing, batching) please ping eng-ml for accuracy checks. Small sequence diagrams are fine but keep them high-level. I can review TTLs and labels — avoid hard numbers that imply guarantees.

leah-product: I'll review the messaging copy. Quick notes:
- For cache: avoid exact % claims — say "typical token savings" or "reduces downstream token usage"
- Routing diagram: label tiers (low-cost, balanced, high-accuracy) and note automatic fallback
- Add a tiny footnote: "Model and quantization recommendations are workload dependent."
I'll post final copy by tomorrow noon.

brandbot: Brand reminder: use approved color hex codes and spacing tokens. Primary hexes: #0A2540, #0B6FFF, #14D1A1. Use Redwood Sans; do not substitute weights. Add accessibility check: contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text.

jake-design: Thanks — noted. Quick Q on filenames and handoff: propose this convention:
`launch_micro_<topic>_<locale>_v1.<ext>`
Example: `launch_micro_latencycost_en_v1.png`
That OK?

maria-marketing: Yes, that naming works. Owners: Jake — design lead; Oliver — creative/animation; Leah — product copy; Sam — engineering review; Maria — campaign QA + final signoff. Please drop drafts in the Figma file and tag me when ready. :thumbsup:

jake-design: I'll spin up component library in Figma today and drop first pass of hero + 4 modular tiles by EOD tomorrow. Will label frames with TODOs for localization.

maria-marketing: Perfect. If anything blocks, ping me or @leah-product. Thanks team — let's keep visuals crisp and simple. :rocket:

jake-design: Roger. :eyes: Tracking in the marketing board under "launch creative — micro infographics"

oliver-creative: Adding animation notes and two motion tests to the Figma prototype later today.

sam-solutions: I'll start a quick tech review thread once mockups are in.

maria-marketing: Closing loop — I added the localization spreadsheet to the Figma file and invited translation partners. Will post final copy tomorrow. :sparkles:
